methodologyNote: BDB-2027 & nflverse 2022-2024 calibrated 20 Hz engine. N=40 snaps/play/front in Part 1, N=24 in Part 2, N=20 in 2D frontier. ELITE_POCKET_52M shares exact physics pool with ELITE_POCKET_13M_CTRL to isolate salary-cap delta with zero Monte Carlo noise. Includes durability caps (<=25%, <=12% QB run share), anti-mobile NICKEL_QB_SPY_CONTAIN_C1 stress front, and pass-forced trailing-by-14 script.
